description: This file contains internal utility functions for handling session keys within the ai.openclaw.app package, including normalization, validation, resolving agent IDs, and building session key strings.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Normalizes a raw session key string by trimming whitespace or returning 'main' if input is null or empty.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a raw session key string is the canonical main session key, considering special values like 'global' and keys starting with 'agent:'.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdFromMainSessionKey
methods.description: Extracts the agent ID from a session key string if it starts with 'agent:', otherwise returns null.

methods.name: buildNodeMainSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs a session key string for a device and optional agent ID, defaulting to 'main' if agent ID is null or empty.
